correctness.rationale: With T(z,u)=z(u+T/(1-T)) marking vertices and leaves, Lagrange inversion gives [z^m u^k]T^d=(d/m)binom(m,k)binom(m-d-1,k-d) for d<m; the exceptional star d=m has leaf count m. Normalize by sum_k A=(d/m)binom(2m-d-1,m-d). The adjacent-degree ratio A_(d+1,k)/A_(d,k)=((d+1)/d)*((k-d)/(m-d-1)) rises strictly in k, and supports [d,m-1] shift right, proving TP2 including zeros and star. This yields strict stochastic increase for any strictly increasing h, with positive covariance by symmetrizing E[(D-Dprime)(g(D)-g(Dprime))]. Narayana leaf variance and root-degree generating-function derivatives give ED=3m/(m+2), EL=(m+1)/2, EDL=(3m-1)/2 and the displayed covariance/correlation. Independently enumerated plane trees m=2..8 and checked all table coefficients, pair minors through m=29. Neither finite test is a proof for all m.
